description: Get a drop's status: URL, visibility, expiration, size, approximate view count, and its private name (if set). With an account token, owned drops need no managementToken. This reads the DROP's record, not its running app: for a graduated app's live state — is it frozen, when does its clock ring, what did the last runs do — call dropyour_schedule, which asks the app itself. For a server app, `dossier` is its proof dossier (pending, ready or failed, with the reason and the step where it stopped); a ready one carries `verdict`: the runward verdict (clean or gaps), the runward version, the number of decisions (ADR) in the app's mission, the number of gaps, and when it was produced. Read it after you change the app, and tell the owner what it says. For a server app, `usageDuMois` is this month's usage (owner only): page views, the views included in its plan (`plafond`, fair use), and its state: `sous_le_plafond`; `a_prevenir` (at 80 %, or earlier when the month's pace would pass the included views, `depassementVers` being that day of the month); `depasse` (with the consecutive months). Nothing is ever cut, whatever the state: tell the owner that first. To go further, the owner replies to the usage email or writes to support: a person answers, with a custom quote if needed.
name: dropyour_status
title: Check a drop's status
